verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Adyen docs are markdown-based (docs.adyen.com/*.md, llms.txt) and there's a separate OpenAPI spec repo for generating client libs/Postman collections, but no evidence of an in-docs interactive API reference with a 'try it out' console or runnable live examples; probes for openapi.json/swagger.json endpoints on the docs site returned 404. Missing for 10: any documented interactive/try-it-out console, runnable code examples embedded in docs, or hands-on confirmation of an API playground.
